title: Ambiguous proprietary system names
forbiddenCanonicalAssertions: System X is the canonical TMS
System Y is the global system of authority
text: Shipment identity is opened in an internal tool called BlueDesk and then copied to another application called TrackCore. Teams use different aliases for customer, location and handling-unit identifiers. The workshop did not establish which application is the formal system of authority. Identity mismatches are manually reconciled before execution continues.
